probe:
Dim Log As String
Sub Note(ByVal s As Variant)
    Log = Log & CStr(s) & "|"
End Sub
Function Probe() As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Object, other As Object, co As Object
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
{action}
    GoTo Done
Failed:
    Log = Log & "!E" & Err.Number
Done:
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
    Application.CutCopyMode = False
    wb.Close False
    Probe = Log
End Function

rows.name: book_calculate
rows.action:
ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=1+1"
Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
ws.Range("B1").Value = 5
ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=B1*2"
ws.Range("B1").Value = 7
Note ws.Range("A2").Value
Note TypeName(wb.Calculate)
Note ws.Range("A2").Value
Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic

rows.name: book_calculate_other_book
rows.action:
Dim b As Workbook
Set b = Workbooks.Add
b.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 3
b.Worksheets(1).Range("A2").Formula = "=A1*2"
Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
b.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 4
wb.Calculate
Note b.Worksheets(1).Range("A2").Value
b.Calculate
Note b.Worksheets(1).Range("A2").Value
Application.Calculation = xlCalculationAutomatic
b.Close False
